Honest Review – Mixed Experience I purchased this Vitamin C and Turmeric Face Scrub Cream three times in the past because I really liked how it worked initially and thought it was a good value. The scrub has a pleasant natural ingredient list (like turmeric, vitamin C, aloe vera, and walnut shell powder) that’s supposed to help exfoliate, brighten, and clear skin. The first couple of times I used it, it seemed fine and did what I expected without any issues. However, the most recent jar I bought had a strong, weird smell right out of the package, unlike the mild scent advertised. After using it on my face, my skin started breaking out with irritation and redness, which I’ve never experienced with previous purchases. Because of that reaction, I won’t be using this product again. It could be that I got a bad batch, or the formula has changed — but either way, it was enough of a negative experience that I won’t repurchase. Pros: • Natural-sounding ingredients • Good exfoliation when it worked • Affordable Cons: • Weird smell on most recent purchase • Caused facial irritation and breakouts for me • Inconsistent experience Wouldn’t recommend based on my latest experience.

I’ve been using this turmeric face mask for a time now and it has quickly become a favorite in my skincare routine! The mask has a pleasant, natural scent not too strong and the creamy texture goes on smoothly without dragging or clumping. After each use, my skin feels noticeably brighter and more even. The turmeric ingredient gives it antioxidant benefits and seems to help calm redness and dullness, leaving my complexion looking refreshed and radiant. I also appreciate that it doesn’t feel harsh or irritating—even on days when my skin is a bit sensitive. It rinses off easily without drying my skin out, and there’s no greasy residue left behind. My skin feels soft and hydrated, not tight or dry like some clay masks can make it feel. Overall, this turmeric face mask delivers glowing results and feels like a little self-care treat. I’d definitely recommend it if you’re looking to brighten and soothe your skin with a natural-feeling product!

For the morning I do the cera ve benzoyl peroxide foaming cream for a cleanser and then use the thayers toner with a vitamin c day cream. Disclaimer: this is what has worked from me, from my aunts advise who has seen a dermatologist since she was very young! (She uses this scrub and it was her recommendation for me).
